items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And Bobby Troup. You know a lot of people who liked music started coming in there.

ctx.x: And Bobby Troup. You know a lot of people who liked music started coming in there.
And that was good for a while. And pretty soon we started getting different bookings, and we’d get ourselves a group, a rhythm section, and yeah, we’re on the road.
